review_type: Independent source and static write-surface review; policy script not executed.
disposition: Clear for the separately authorized operator action after the exact second failed promotion is abandoned and the idle state hash is freshly reviewed.
verified_guards: Exact reviewed canonical state hash, no active lease and the original six-hour policy are required.
The exact second failed candidate must be recorded as abandoned; the existing live predecessor must remain unchanged.
The AWS identity is checked against the fixed account; preparation and execution workflow roles are refused.
The existing healthy runtime boundary is checked read-only before the proposed policy write.
The prospective ten-hour-shortened successor with two task-hours must pass the existing canonical budget validator at execution time; this prospective reservation is not written to the ledger.

The private receipt binds source, identity, before/after state hashes, policy and prospective budget proof, and is written create-only under the enforced immutable promotions prefix before the state CAS.

The CAS changes only policy.shorten_expiry_hours and one revision increment. Full readback must match the expected state, preserving the ledger, allowances, caps, live configuration, aliases and identities.
An unknown write outcome is not retried automatically. A successful prior write fails the original-policy guard on a later invocation.

rejected_create_recovery_source_review.disposition: No remaining blocker in the explicitly opted-in recovery for the exact missing bootstrap-version permission rejection.
verified_behavior: The exact canonical request and token remain journal evidence. A unique bounded run-session CloudTrail event must identify the exact bootstrap-SSM ValidationException; missing CloudTrail parameters are explicitly recorded, not treated as an observed token match.
All prior ECR and template operations require matching immutable receipt bytes, hashes and closed envelopes; uploaded template bytes and canonical create intent must match.

The original run must be terminal past the 65-minute credential fence. Operator identity, reviewed state hash, complete change-set inventories, two exact ChangeSetNotFound 404 observations and healthy retained runtime boundaries are required.

The original intent remains intact in evidence. Unknown or different errors, foreign sessions, ambiguous events, changed requests, an existing or pending change set, incomplete reads and a concurrent state change refuse recovery.
Recovery does not replay CreateChangeSet or alter runtime services. It retains the failed window and allowances and conditionally records abandonment.

verification.transport: Offline synthetic AWS and GitHub transport; real recovery, journal, state and budget logic.

limits: This records source review, not application of the policy or execution of abandonment.
Ten hours becomes the persistent shortening default until another explicit idle-state review changes it; there is no automatic reset.
The policy-only write does not change current service counts or expiry schedules. The next promotion calculates and displays its own prospective expiry for human approval.
Reported projected costs and the next expiry are not replayed or claimed as applied here. The script must pass the actual canonical reserve again when the operator runs it.
Detailed local and S3 receipts remain private. No raw account identifiers, resource ARNs, capabilities or real user data are copied here.
